column3: The names are explicitly mentioned, and filling their hand has an active singular subject.
“Before the face of Aaron” is retained rather than explicitly “during the lifetime”; “since” and “only” are not separately stated.
The tribe is initially singular, followed by a plural subject serving him.
The tabernacle is not explicitly repeated as the object approached.
Opening the womb is explicitly stated.
The sons of Levi and the house of their fathers are explicitly named.
“By the mouth of the LORD” retains the body image.
